description: This file defines the Ec2ParamBuilder class, which extends QueryParamBuilder, and provides methods for building query parameters specific to EC2 API requests, including handling list serialization and shape naming.

classes.name: Ec2ParamBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for building query parameters for EC2 API requests in AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: queryName
methods.description: Determines the query name for a given shape, defaulting to its location name with capitalization if not specified.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Indicates that the shape is not flat; always returns false.

methods.name: format_list
methods.description: Serializes a list shape into query parameters, handling list items by invoking the format method for each.
